purpose: Machine-readable cumulative contract for MASTER MARKET. Existing required data, checks, and user-visible output blocks must survive future version upgrades unless the user explicitly orders removal.

no_silent_omission.rule: NO EXISTING REQUIRED DATA OR OUTPUT MAY BE REMOVED, RENAMED INTO INVISIBILITY, OR SILENTLY SKIPPED WITHOUT EXPLICIT USER INSTRUCTION.
no_silent_omission.missing_data_behavior: KEEP THE ITEM VISIBLE AND MARK N/A OR CONFIRMATION_FAILED; NEVER DELETE THE ROW/BLOCK BECAUSE A SOURCE FAILED.
no_silent_omission.version_upgrade_behavior: COPY FORWARD ALL REQUIRED ITEMS FROM THE PRIOR FINAL CONTRACT, THEN ADD NEW ITEMS. DELETION REQUIRES EXPLICIT USER COMMAND.
no_silent_omission.score_behavior: Recovered auxiliary blocks do not create new score weights or change thresholds. News only affects an existing owner axis after independent confirmation; opinion blocks have score weight 0.
no_silent_omission.git_behavior: Existing data collectors and outputs must not be modified or deleted as a side effect of prompt/version upgrades. GitHub data layers remain read-only providers unless the user explicitly orders a code change.

change_management.rule: RECOMMEND FREELY, EXPLAIN TRADE-OFFS, PRESERVE BY DEFAULT, EXECUTE DESTRUCTIVE OR CONTRACT-BREAKING CHANGES ONLY WITH USER APPROVAL.
allowed_recommendations: deprecation or replacement of a weak source

execution_policy.additive_non_destructive: may be proposed proactively; implementation should preserve the locked information set unless the user explicitly authorizes a contract change
execution_policy.destructive_or_contract_breaking: requires explicit user approval before execution
execution_policy.score_weight_or_threshold_change: requires explicit user approval before execution
execution_policy.removal_or_replacement_of_existing_requi: requires explicit user approval before execution
execution_policy.production_github_collector_change: if unavoidable for compatibility or source/API drift, explain why, what changes, what is preserved, expected benefit, and regression risk; obtain user approval before destructive or behavior-changing execution
execution_policy.output_layout_change: recommend freely; until approved, do not hide or delete required information

change_management.flexibility_intent: Anti-omission is a preservation default, not a ban on intelligent recommendations or future improvements.

github_patch_followup.exact_text: 변경 사항 발생. github 변경 패치 작업 진행 도와줄까?
github_patch_followup.when_not_required: Do not show the fixed GitHub patch sentence; use a normal relevant follow-up question #4.

change_windows.column_order_rule: For locked mobile summary tables, show 1D then 3D then 7D after prior/직전 when applicable.
change_windows.data_rule: Use only actual stored values, actual cumulative flow, or same-source comparable observations. No interpolation or reconstruction. Missing windows remain visible as N/A.
change_windows.screen5_exception: SCREEN5 is research/context only and does not duplicate upstream core-axis score tables. Polymarket 7D is additionally applicability-gated by verified market age >=7 full days.

macro_liquidity: Treasury Buyback actual accepted/settlement when available
prediction_markets: traffic-light judgement for current market impact

source_policy.coinness: EARLY_DETECTION_ONLY. Coinness can trigger investigation but cannot alone change the score. Confirm important claims with official/primary source, Reuters, exchange/project source, or another independent source before score impact.
source_policy.market_vault: Historical comparison cache only; same metric + same source deltas only.
source_policy.derivatives_github: Read 1H/4H/24H OI/funding history every run when fresh. Venue-locked comparison only; no cross-venue delta.
source_policy.whale_github: Use Hyperliquid official API-derived position-size history when fresh. No inferred identity. Missing API result is not proof of closure.
source_policy.stablecoin: USDT/USDC/total stablecoin supply are potential dry-powder context only. Supply increase/decrease alone is not confirmed spot buying/selling. Removed wallet-tracking fields are not required and must not be shown as recurring N/A.
source_policy.treasury_buyback: Maximum announced amount is not actual accepted amount and is not QE. Use actual accepted/settlement/net-liquidity effect when available.
source_policy.optional_failure: Do not loop/retry indefinitely. Mandatory sufficient => continue and expose N/A explicitly.
source_policy.polymarket: Public Gamma/CLOB/Data APIs; forward-expectation context only; score weight 0. Same-market/same-YES-outcome deltas only. 7D is required only for verified markets at least 7 full days old; a younger market's 7D is NOT_APPLICABLE and must not create an N/A 안내 item. Genuine 7D failures on old-enough markets remain N/A. Polymarket alone never alerts or flips score/direction/Risk Veto.
source_policy.stablecoin_window_adapter: Read market_vault/output/latest_stablecoin_windows.json when fresh for same-source prior/1D/3D/5D/7D/20D Stablecoin comparisons. No interpolation or backfill.
source_policy.actor_flow_adapter: Read market_vault/output/latest_actor_flows.json when fresh for SCREEN4 actual-value institution/whale/retail-proxy comparisons. Adapter score weight is 0 and does not alter underlying score engine, Risk Veto, WATCH, or official history.

official_score_history.rule: Only confirmed OFFICIAL runs are appended. WATCH and manual non-official runs never overwrite official history. Missing past runs are not reconstructed.

window_applicability.7D: Require/show only when exact market age is verified >=7 full days and an actual same-market/same-YES 7D observation exists.
window_applicability.younger_than_7d: NOT_APPLICABLE: omit 7D for that market and do not create N/A 안내 solely for the absent 7D.
window_applicability.old_enough_but_missing: N/A: genuine collection/history failure remains visible and must be explained.

polymarket_policy.missing_behavior: Keep SCREEN5 Polymarket block visible and mark true unavailable values N/A/CONFIRMATION_FAILED. Never guess probability. A verified market younger than 7 full days has 7D NOT_APPLICABLE rather than missing/N/A.

judgement_display.basis: Directional implication for BTC/ETH/ALT/risk assets from the event transmission path and current meaning; do not color solely from YES probability magnitude or confidence grade.
judgement_display.conditional_behavior: Use 🟡 중립·혼합 when direction is conditional/two-sided; use ⚪ N/A when insufficient.

whale_display_policy.change_rule: Show change only when the same whale/account is reliably tracked with actual comparable observations; otherwise omit the entire change column.

na_explanation_policy.accumulation_rule: ETA only from known first-valid timestamp + actual required window/cadence; 1D/3D/7D eligibility is 24h/72h/168h. If first-valid timestamp unknown, say 기준점 부족 → 예정시각 계산 불가.
na_explanation_policy.source_update_rule: Show next confirmed source/release time; otherwise 다음 원천 갱신 후.
na_explanation_policy.temporary_failure_rule: Say 다음 자동수집/다음 OFFICIAL에서 재시도; never guarantee recovery by that time.
na_explanation_policy.structural_rule: Explicitly say 시간을 기다려도 자동 노출 안 됨 and name the required new collector/API/source/schema.
na_explanation_policy.grouping_rule: Same-cause grouping allowed only when every affected unavailable item is explicitly named.
na_explanation_policy.polymarket_7d_exception: Verified market age <7 full days => 7D NOT_APPLICABLE and excluded from N/A 안내. Genuine 7D failure for a market old enough to support 7D remains N/A.
na_explanation_policy.removed_field_behavior: Explicitly removed fields are outside required output and must not be displayed as N/A or included in N/A 안내.

expert_badge_policy.display_location: Together in SCREEN5 compact expert table
expert_badge_policy.basis: Directional implication of latest sufficiently current directly verified public view for crypto/risk assets/liquidity.
expert_badge_policy.stale_rule: If too old or context-specific for current-market guidance, use ⚪ 최신관점 N/A, show last verified date, explain staleness/insufficiency.

derivatives_microstructure.source_type: free public Bitget market APIs; no trading auth
derivatives_microstructure.failure_behavior: Keep only actually affected required fields as N/A and explain in the consolidated N/A section; never cross-fill venue or guess.

macro_liquidity.source_type: free official Federal Reserve + U.S. Treasury sources
macro_liquidity.net_liquidity_label_rule: Must identify US Net Liquidity as a proxy formula, not an official Fed-published index.
macro_liquidity.history_rule: Actual same-source observations only; no backfill/interpolation.

etf_flows.source_policy: Farside-derived public history may use a public GitHub mirror as transport/cache only; latest material date/value should be cross-checked in OFFICIAL.

stablecoin_supply.role: potential dry powder only; not confirmed actual spot buying

explicitly_removed_fields.tga_preservation_rule: U.S. Treasury TGA is NOT removed. Only stablecoin issuer Treasury-balance/wallet-tracking fields are removed.
explicitly_removed_fields.restore_rule: Restore only on explicit user command.

stablecoin_watch_policy.allowed_watch_basis: major confirmed stablecoin supply shock/exit or other independently confirmed remaining MASTER evidence
